title: OKR Initiative Concord: cross-functional staging lanes and rollback policy
creator: Aisha Patel
description:
Background: As Redwood scales, cross-functional initiatives routinely slip when staging, rollout gates, and rollback policies are not consistently defined. This ticket scopes a lightweight but prescriptive "Concord"—an OKR Initiative Concordance that defines staging lanes (alpha/internal, canary, progressive, full), required readiness checks per lane, and a standard rollback policy and escalation runway for company-level initiatives tied to OKRs.

Objectives: 
- Create a repeatable staging+gate checklist for initiatives that span Product, Eng, Design, and Infra.
- Define a default rollback policy and SLA-driven escalation path (who does what at T+0, T+15, T+60 minutes).
- Produce an onboarding doc and a one-page decision tree for PMs and Eng leads.
- Surface an initial risk heatmap and integration plan for Q2 OKRs.

Scope & non-goals: 
- In scope: company-level initiatives (OKR owners + multi-team work), gating criteria for deployment lanes, escalation assignments, and example runbooks.
- Out of scope: per-service incident runbooks; deep surgical playbooks for infra incidents (these remain in SRE IR process).

Success metrics: 
- 80% of company-level initiative leads adopt the Concord checklist in their kickoff within the next cycle.
- Reduction in rollout-related rollbacks by 40% vs. previous quarter for tracked initiatives.
- Average time-to-decision during a rollout incident reduced from 38 minutes to 20 minutes (measured against rollouts instrumented in Console).

Deliverables: 
1) "Concord" staging lanes doc (Confluence) + one-page PDF.
2) Template readiness checklist (tied to Console's rollout fields).
3) Rollback policy + escalation matrix with named owners and Slack channels.
4) Risk heatmap for Q2 OKRs with recommended mitigations.
5) Training slot (30 min) for PMs/Eng leads + recording.

Stakeholders: PMs (Aisha Patel owner), Engineering leadership (Marco Li assignee), Design (Priya Raman), SRE (Diego Alvarez), Legal/Compliance for Private deployments (as consult).
acceptance_criteria: Concord doc published in Confluence with versioning and a linked one-page checklist
Template ready checklist available in the PM template library and linked in new-initiative flow
Rollback policy approved by Eng leadership and SRE; escalation matrix includes primary/secondary on-call contacts
At least 3 initiative leads trial the Concord checklist during their next staging cycle and provide feedback
Risk heatmap added to company OKR dashboard and a mitigation plan attached
